## Batch 3 authoring complete

I completed the seven draft items, both frontmatter-only pages, the batch manifest, proof contracts, dependency inputs, and notes. The PAC definition now specifies the measurable learner maps. The examples state their sample assumptions explicitly; the zero-training-error example no longer depends on the sample-complexity theorem, so its item level is 4.

The independent source locators and dispositions are in the [batch coverage file](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-3.coverage.json). I read the relevant complete arguments in [Shalev-Shwartz and Ben-David’s book](https://www.inf.u-szeged.hu/~turan/ML-Konyv.pdf) and reused the preserved full-text retrieval for Mohri et al., listed there and on the [authors’ book page](https://cs.nyu.edu/~mohri/mlbook/).

Scoped precheck, proof layout, strict proof contracts, rendering, content policy, depcheck, and the focused statement-first check all passed. The source fetch check reported **2/2 verified**, with no new stamps or dropped sources.

## Owner holds

The ordinary readiness recorder could not write a record: it rejected a duplicate `ex-singular-mahalanobis-metric-identifies-distinct-points` entry in batch 24. The run-wide dependency-level check also reports stale levels, and the whole-run statement-first check stops at batch 10’s empty inventory. These shared artifacts remain unchanged. The [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-3.notes.md) record the exact errors and the intended item dispositions.

Owner reconciliation is also needed for the published suppliers `thm-finite-class-uniform-deviation` and `lem-bounded-variable-hoeffding-mgf`: both lack the `audited` or `verified` marker required by the schema. That holds the agnostic bound and its sample-complexity and two example consumers. The choice-free proof route remains intact; the AC-dependent Hoeffding alternative was not used.

The recomputed run status is `1-scaffold`, 25/101 covered, with no workers in flight and an existing owner repair/recertification blocker. No published content, shared plan, owner verdict, or engine state was changed.

Artifacts: [batch pages](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-3.pages.json), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-3.proof-contracts.json), and [dependency inputs](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-3.dependency-inputs.json).
